name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first' makes at_exit only the condition of an 'if', not a goal, so no Existence(at_exit) is wanted. The single hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) is exactly the rule: the exit may not be reached before the switch has been toggled, and it holds when the exit is never reached. The empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid for this conditional task, and the machine's rejecting state on (at_exit&!switch_toggled) matches the hard break.

texts: If the exit is reached, the switch must have been toggled first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
